name: Edric Godwinson
vampire_desc: A twenty-year-old peasant raised in a small village. A farmer used to the feel of the sickle. Preparing to marry.

marks.description: A shadow that no longer obeys me. Flickering and moving of its own accord, even without candlelight. I can feel it staring at me. I think I hear its voice in my head.
marks.concealment: I walk in places without shadows. It is a poor concealment at best.

experiences: A twenty-year-old peasant raised in a small village. A farmer used to the feel of the sickle. Preparing to marry.

Edith and I talk during a church gathering. She gives me the Saints Charm as a gift. 
I'm looking forward to our wedding so we can build our family together.

Working the farm with my sickle, I remember to pay our share of the rent and grain collection to Leofric.
He doesn't extort extra, and for that I'm grateful.

I spend hours each day with my sickle and knife, working the farm and repairing the house. 
I don't complain so long as I have food at the end of the day.

I am attacked by a dark shadow. I never know its name. I am inside with my family when I hear noises coming from the barn. Sounds like a predator is attacking the oxen. I take my talisman into my hands and head out to scare off the predators. I wake up days later inside with a fever. My talisman burns my hands.
On my deathbed, Father Godric comes to save my soul. My last rites become his as I murder him and drink his blood.

resources.name: Sickle
resources.description: Worn at the handle, but the blade is kept sharp. Used for harvesting crops, cutting grass, and cutting other things.

resources.name: Saints Charm
resources.description: Something I wear for protection against Evil forces.

resources.name: Knife
resources.description: I always carry an iron knife. I use it for eating, cutting rope, preparing food, and minor repairs. I carried one constantly.

characters.name: Edith atte Brook
characters.description: My betrothed. She seemed outwardly cold to others, but I felt the well of emotion hidden behind even the smallest smile. She and I wanted the same things—a house, a family, a good harvest.

characters.name: Father Godric
characters.description: Leader in the village church. Leads Mass. Responsible for baptisms and burials. I never had any spiritual matters that required advice, but that all changed...
characters.death_epitaph: Here lies Father Godric. Year of our lord 1020. You don't know it though because his grave is unmarked.

characters.name: Leofric the Reeve
characters.description: The overseer of our harvesting, as well as the rent and grain collector for our lord. Usually fair, sometimes harsh. He was the one who enforced the laws.

characters.name: The Dark Shadow
characters.description: The dark shape in the barn. It is gone before I learn it's name.

journal.experience:
Edith is at my bedside throughout my fever. We pray together for salvation. We know I may not be long for this world. My hopes. My dreams. All turning to ashes and dust.
Night comes. I already feel dead. I think my torment is finally over when Father Godric comes to deliver the last rites. 
He closes the curtains. He gives me Eucharist. The bread and wine do nothing but stir a hunger in me that I can't control. I kill him and sustain myself on his blood. I feel stronger than I ever have before. 
I bury his body in his churchyard. I don't leave a marker.
journal.changes: Killed Father Godric. Gained Skill Bloodthirsty
